prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: editorial photograph for an Australian practical skills field guide website. Primary request: a warm, beautifully composed, authentic still life of everyday country-living tools on a weathered wooden workbench on the shaded veranda of a rural Australian shed: canvas work gloves, a claw hammer with timber handle, coiled natural rope, an old green metal toolbox, a small stainless torch, tape measure. The tools look usable and neatly set out, not showroom. Background through the open side is softly out of focus, dry golden paddock, eucalyptus trees and distant hills. Afternoon sunlight across timber, sage green and honey tones, subtle film grain, grounded editorial magazine photography. Landscape 3:2 composition. No text, no logos, no people, no instructional diagram, no weapons, no watermark. This supports a welcoming website about learning practical home and rural skills.
